fields.Name: T083 - Permissions Resource Access
fields.Description: Opens the Permissions app's Resource Access surface once, then walks its behaviors (domain-switch repopulates resource types, required-field lookup guard, and grantee-resolution lookup), verifying each via checkpoints. Consolidates old T221, T222, T223.

InputDefinition.goal: You are logged in at http://localhost:4200. Open the Permissions app via the application switcher dropdown next to the logo, then click 'Resource Access' in the left nav. Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away. The surface shows a 'Domain:' dropdown, a 'Resource Type:' combobox, and a 'Resource ID:' text input. Then walk these behaviors IN ORDER, and as you arrive at each one set "checkpointReached" to the exact checkpoint name shown: (1) domain-switch-populates-types — open the 'Domain:' dropdown and select a different permission domain, and confirm the 'Resource Type:' combobox reacts — its selectable options update to that domain's resource types (open it to confirm, or note it auto-fills a single type) and any now-invalid prior value is cleared; (2) lookup-requires-type-and-id — leaving at least one of 'Resource Type:' or 'Resource ID:' blank, click the 'Lookup' button and confirm the lookup is BLOCKED with a validation error stating that resource type and resource ID are both required (no grantee results table appears); (3) lookup-shows-grantees — now pick a Domain, choose or type a Resource Type, enter any plausible UUID-shaped identifier in 'Resource ID:', and click 'Lookup', then confirm the query RUNS and shows either a grantee table (Grantee / Type / Actions / Effect / Expires columns) with a count OR a clearly labeled 'No grantees found' empty-state echoing the query. Keep going until all three behaviors are done.

checkpoints.name: domain-switch-populates-types
checkpoints.instruction: Domain change repopulates Resource Type combobox
visualCriteria: The Resource Access surface renders with Domain dropdown, Resource Type combobox, and Resource ID input, and changing the Domain selection updates the Resource Type combobox options (or auto-selects a single type / clears a now-invalid prior value)

checkpoints.name: lookup-requires-type-and-id
visualCriteria: Clicking 'Lookup' with a blank Resource Type and/or Resource ID surfaces a validation error message indicating both fields are required, and no grantee results table is shown

checkpoints.name: lookup-shows-grantees
visualCriteria: After entering a domain, resource type, and resource ID and clicking Lookup, the surface shows either a grantee table (Grantee / Type / Actions / Effect / Expires columns) with a count OR a clearly labeled 'No grantees found' empty-state referencing the query
